deploy-bot: [STAGING] Pipeline triggered for tag v2.3.0 (commit abcdef9) by maria. Change window 2026-03-20 18:00-19:00 UTC. Jobs: build → unit-tests → lint → smoke. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2345
sam: on standby, ping me if we need to hold the window.
deploy-bot: build: PASSED (12m) • unit-tests: PASSED (8m) • lint: FAILED (see summary) :warning:
deploy-bot: Lint summary: 3 files with errors. Example output:
```
packages/runtime/src/kv_cache.rs:42: trailing_whitespace
packages/console/src/rollout.ts:128: no-explicit-any
integrations/model-onboarder.py:77: F401 'utils' imported but unused
```
lee: looks like the runtime rename from yesterday caused the lint break (kv_cache path changes). I can patch but might be ~20-30m.
maria: we need this out in the window if possible. Options: hotfix PR with patch (20-30m) or pin pipeline to previous commit abc1230 and re-run. Thoughts?
sam: lint is a blocking gate for staging -> canary. We don't normally bypass. Pin sounds faster for shipping, but document it in release notes. :eyes:
lee: agree pin is lowest-risk short-term. I'll still open a fix PR. @maria do you want me to apply the pin?
maria: yes, apply pin to abc1230 and re-run. I'll update the release notes with a known-issue entry.
deploy-bot: pin applied. Re-triggered pipeline on commit abc1230 (tag v2.3.0-pin-20260320). New CI: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2346
deploy-bot: re-run: build: PASSED • unit-tests: PASSED • smoke: STARTED
maria: smoke check: exercise /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings for sanity.
deploy-bot: smoke job logs (snippet):
```
[2026-03-20T18:05:12Z] POST /v1/generate -> 502 runtime-gpu-01
[2026-03-20T18:05:13Z] POST /v1/embeddings -> 200 OK
[2026-03-20T18:05:15Z] POST /v1/generate -> 502 runtime-gpu-02
```
lee: 502 on /v1/generate from two replicas, looks like an inference path regression. I touched kv cache and kernel selection yesterday, will check logs now. ETA ~25m.
deploy-bot: smoke: FAILED (502) across 3 replicas. Fallback policy: if no fix within 30m, rollback to v2.2.5 automatically.
sam: decision needed: hold + triage or immediate rollback to v2.2.5 and cut fastpatch? We need to keep the change window SLA.
maria: I'm leaning rollback if lee is not confident in <30m. I'll draft release notes for both scenarios and notify support channel.
lee: triage in progress, root cause likely kernel selector edge-case with short sequences. If I can push a targeted runtime hotfix within 20-25m, we can avoid rollback. Otherwise do rollback.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0320 created. Severity: low. Owner: lee. https://inc.redwood.example/INC-2026-0320 :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: pipeline status: ABORTED at smoke; action=hold_by_oncall. Please follow incident for updates.
sam: noted. I'll hold the change window announcement until we know outcome. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: thanks all — lee keep us posted, if you need a rollback command I can approve immediately.
lee: will update in the incident thread in ~20m.
